## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her habitual lateness, which some attribute to a desire to make a dramatic entrance. She exhibits dishonest behavior and irritates others by constantly squeaking her pencil while writing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school following a brief absence, Gertie and her peers gave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a warm welcome. She later attended [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school events, such as the highly successful local Christmas concert.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
